content: We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1739 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need number of carbonyl groups. Could be more than one carbonyl; IR only shows one strong carbonyl peak. Could be multiple carbonyls overlapping. Need more info about molecule. No SMILES given. Could retrieve carbon shifts? Not needed. Maybe we can get 13C NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
